pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
print(pw)
phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_num='9312015677'
print('phone_pw_len',len(phone_pw))
res=apis.phone.login(username=phone_num,password=phone_pw)
print(res)
phone_token=res.get('access_token')
print('phone_token_set',bool(phone_token))

# List all phone alarms (paginated)
alarms=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=phone_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>20:
        break
print('total_alarms',len(alarms))
# Print concise summary
for a in alarms:
    print(a.get('alarm_id'),a.get('time'),a.get('repeat_days'),a.get('label'),a.get('enabled'))
